# Histone Mark Enrichment
```{julia}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

# Libraries
include("prelude.jl")
using CategoricalArrays
using JSON
using PlotlyJS
using Printf
using Serialization

# Serialized data
data_dir = "../../dicty_data/"
ser_data_dir = joinpath(data_dir, "julia_serialized")
tss_dS_enrich_newds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "tss_enrich_plots_dS_All_newds.jls"))
body_dS_enrich_newds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "body_enrich_plots_dS_All_newds.jls"))
tes_dS_enrich_newds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "tes_enrich_plots_dS_All_newds.jls"))
bar_dS_newds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "bar_plots_dS_All_newds.jls"))
tss_dS_enrich_oldds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "tss_enrich_plots_dS_All.jls"))
body_dS_enrich_oldds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "body_enrich_plots_dS_All.jls"))
tes_dS_enrich_oldds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "tes_enrich_plots_dS_All.jls"))
bar_dS_oldds = deserialize(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "bar_plots_dS_All.jls"))
expr_dec_oldds = JSON.parsefile(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "expression_deciles.json"))
expr_dec_newds = JSON.parsefile(joinpath(ser_data_dir, "expression_deciles_new_ds.json"))
expr_pairs_oldds = CSV.read(joinpath(data_dir, "filtered/paralog_expr_ds.csv"), DataFrame)
expr_pairs_newds = CSV.read(joinpath(data_dir, "filtered/paralog_expr_ds_new_ds.csv"), DataFrame)

# MLR results
mlr_old = CSV.read(joinpath(data_dir, "mlr_results_All_old_ds.csv"), DataFrame)
mlr_new = CSV.read(joinpath(data_dir, "mlr_results_All_new_ds.csv"), DataFrame)
mlr_stats_old = readlines(joinpath(data_dir, "mlr_stats_All_old_ds.txt"))
mlr_stats_new = readlines(joinpath(data_dir, "mlr_stats_All_new_ds.txt"))

# Plot parameters
const x_tick_font = attr(family="Times New Roman", size=26)
const y_tick_font = attr(family="Times New Roman", size=36)
const title_font_size = 30
const vertical_spacing = 0.025
const x1_vals = [collect(-400:100:-100)...]
const x2_vals = [collect(20:20:80)...]
const x3_vals = [collect(100:100:400)...]

# Helper functions
function base_fig()
    return make_subplots(
        rows=2, cols=3,
        column_widths=[0.5*0.75, 1*0.75, 0.5*0.75],
        row_heights=[0.50, 0.50],
        horizontal_spacing=0.002,
        vertical_spacing=vertical_spacing,
        specs=[Spec(kind="heatmap") Spec(kind="heatmap") Spec(kind="heatmap");
               Spec(kind="heatmap") Spec(kind="heatmap") Spec(kind="heatmap");]
    )
end
function add_row(
    fig, 
    tss_plts, 
    body_plts, 
    tes_plts, 
    sample_idx, 
    top_row
    )
    row_idx = top_row ? 1 : 2
    add_trace!(fig, tss_plts[1][sample_idx], row=row_idx, col=1)
    add_trace!(fig, body_plts[1][sample_idx], row=row_idx, col=2)
    add_trace!(fig, tes_plts[1][sample_idx], row=row_idx, col=3)
end
function relayout_top!(fig)
    relayout!(fig, yaxis=attr(tickfont=y_tick_font,
                              title="log(TPM + 0.5)",
                              titlefont=attr(family = "Times New Roman",
                              size=title_font_size)),
                xaxis=attr(range=[-500,0],
                            showticklabels=false),
                yaxis2=attr(showticklabels=false),
                xaxis2=attr(showticklabels=false),
                yaxis3=attr(showticklabels=false),
                xaxis3=attr(range=[0,500], 
                            showticklabels=false))
end

function relayout_bottom!(fig)
    relayout!(fig, 
                yaxis4=attr(tickfont=y_tick_font, 
                               title="𝑑𝑆", 
                               titlefont=attr(family = "Times New Roman", 
                               size=title_font_size, 
                               weight="bold")),
                xaxis4=attr(range=[-500,0], 
                            tickmode="array", 
                            tickvals=x1_vals, 
                            ticktext=[string.(x1_vals)...], 
                            tickfont=x_tick_font),
                yaxis5=attr(showticklabels=false),
                xaxis5=attr(tickmode="array", 
                            tickvals=x2_vals, 
                            ticktext=string.(x2_vals) .* "%", 
                            tickfont=x_tick_font),
                yaxis6=attr(showticklabels=false),
                xaxis6=attr(range=[0,500], 
                            tickmode="array", 
                            tickvals=x3_vals, 
                            ticktext=["+" .* string.(x3_vals)...], 
                            tickfont=x_tick_font))
end

function remove_heatmap_colorbars!(fig)
    # PlotlyJS sometimes wraps plots in `SyncPlot` for display; the underlying plot is in `.plot`.
    plt = hasproperty(fig, :plot) ? getproperty(fig, :plot) : fig

    # Hide per-trace colorbars.
    if hasproperty(plt, :data)
        for tr in plt.data
            ty = try
                tr[:type]
            catch
                nothing
            end
            if ty == "heatmap"
                tr[:showscale] = false
            end
        end
    end

    # Hide shared coloraxis colorbars too (coloraxis, coloraxis2, ...).
    if hasproperty(plt, :layout)
        if haskey(plt.layout, :coloraxis)
            plt.layout[:coloraxis][:showscale] = false
        end
        try
            for k in keys(plt.layout)
                if startswith(String(k), "coloraxis")
                    ca = plt.layout[k]
                    try
                        ca[:showscale] = false
                    catch
                    end
                end
            end
        catch
        end
    end

    return fig
end

function build_fig(tss_plts, body_plts, tes_plts, sample_idx)
    fig = base_fig()
    add_row(
        fig,
        tss_plts,
        body_plts,
        tes_plts,
        sample_idx,
        true
    )
    relayout_top!(fig)
    add_row(
        fig,
        tss_dS_enrich_newds,
        body_dS_enrich_newds,
        tes_dS_enrich_newds,
        sample_idx,
        false
    )
    relayout_bottom!(fig)
    relayout!(
        fig,
        showlegend=false,
        plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        height=600,
        width=1200
    )
    remove_heatmap_colorbars!(fig)
    return fig
end

function build_table(df)
    df = sort(df, :Predictor)
    table = "| Predictor | Coefficient | p-value (adj.) |\n|-|-|-|-|-|"
    for row in eachrow(df)
        table *= "\n| $(row.Predictor) | $(row.Coef) | $(row.pvalue_adj) |"
    end
    return table
end

function build_box_plts_json(expr_deciles1, expr_deciles2, name1, name2)
    deciles = [string(i) for i in 1:10] 
    plts = GenericTrace[]
    for decile in deciles
        plt1 = box(y=expr_deciles1[decile], name="$decile ($name1)", marker_color="blue", line=attr(color="blue"), fillcolor="#596fff")
        plt2 = box(y=expr_deciles2[decile], name="$decile ($name2)", marker_color="crimson", line=attr(color="crimson"), fillcolor="#a72020")
        push!(plts, plt1)
        push!(plts, plt2)
    end
    return plts
end

function build_box_plts_df(expr_df1, expr_df2, name1, name2)
    deciles1 = levelcode.(cut(expr_df1.dS, 10))
    deciles2 = levelcode.(cut(expr_df2.dS, 10))
    plts = GenericTrace[]
    for decile in 1:10
        plt1 = box(y=expr_pairs_oldds.Diff[deciles1 .== decile], name="Decile $decile ($name1)", marker_color="blue", line=attr(color="blue"), fillcolor="#596fff")
        plt2 = box(y=expr_pairs_newds.Diff[deciles2 .== decile], name="Decile $decile ($name2)", marker_color="crimson", line=attr(color="crimson"), fillcolor="#a72020")
        push!(plts, plt1)
        push!(plts, plt2)
    end
    return plts
end
```

# GLM
## Model comparison
```{julia}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

println("""| Predictor | Coefficient (Old) | Coefficient (New) | p-value (adj., Old) | p-value (adj., New) |
|-|-|-|-|-|""")
for i in 1:nrow(mlr_old)
    @printf("| %s | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f | %.2f |\n", mlr_old.Predictor[i], mlr_old.Coef[i], mlr_new.Coef[i], mlr_old.pvalue_adj[i], mlr_new.pvalue_adj[i])
end
```
## R² values for old vs. new dS models
```{julia}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

r2_old = split(mlr_stats_old[1], ":")[2] |> strip
r2_new = split(mlr_stats_new[1], ":")[2] |> strip

println("""| Model | R² |
|-|-|
| Old dS | $r2_old |
| New dS | $r2_new |
""")
```
## VIF values for old vs. new dS models
```{julia}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

# Rempve the headers
mlr_stats_old = mlr_stats_old[4:end]
mlr_stats_new = mlr_stats_new[4:end]

# Extract VIF values
vifs_old = map(mlr_stats_old) do line
    parts = split(line, ":")
    var = strip(parts[1])
    vif = strip(parts[2])
    return (var => vif)
end
vifs_new = map(mlr_stats_new) do line
    parts = split(line, ":")
    var = strip(parts[1])
    vif = strip(parts[2])
    return (var => vif)
end
println("""| Predictor | VIF (Old dS) | VIF (New dS) |
|-|-|-|
$(join(map(1:length(vifs_old)) do i
    var = vifs_old[i][1]
    vif_old = vifs_old[i][2]
    vif_new = vifs_new[i][2]
    "| $var | $vif_old | $vif_new |"
end, "\n"))
""")
```

# Gene expression comparison
## Expression deciles
```{julia}
boxes = build_box_plts_json(expr_dec_oldds, expr_dec_newds, "Old dS", "New dS")
plot(boxes, Layout(title="Gene expression deciles", yaxis_title="dS", xaxis_title=" (<-lower) Expression decile (higher->)", showlegend=false))
```
## Expression difference vs. dS
```{julia}
boxes = build_box_plts_df(expr_pairs_oldds, expr_pairs_newds, "Old dS", "New dS")
plot(boxes, Layout(title="Expression difference vs. dS", yaxis_title="Expression difference", xaxis_title=" (<-lower) dS decile (higher->)", showlegend=false))
```
